findings.text: correctness lens, medium: When `--resume --from-stage <s>` is used, `_runner_resume_rehydrate` (line 2946, unconditional in the resume block) and `_runner_from_stage_preflight` (line 3036, conditional on `from_stage`) both call `_artifact_persist_restore` + `_artifact_persist_put_back` to the same `state_dir/artifacts`; the second restore is entirely redundant since `_runner_resume_rehydrate` already placed every artifact before `_runner_from_stage_preflight` runs, doubling the git-archive cost and producing confusing warning messages if the second `put_back` encounters a transient failure after the first succeeded. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:2946; fix: code)

correctness lens, medium: `_cycle_state_jq_write_iter_start` uses `(.cycle_iterations[$id] //= {iter:[]})` as its fallback default — an incomplete schema (missing `status`, `current_iter`, `max_iterations`, `history_file`) compared to `_cycle_state_jq_init`'s full default; if `_cycle_state_write_iter_start` is ever reached when `_cycle_state_init` has not yet written its full object (e.g., if `locked_state_update` creates the key in a concurrent write before init fires), subsequent `get_state_field` calls for `max_iterations` or `status` on that object silently return their zero/empty defaults, corrupting orchestrator state without any error. (core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh:1227; fix: code)
